newsitem.title: USA: Cabletron Q4 results in line, shares rise.
newsitem.headline: Cabletron Q4 results in line, shares rise.

text.p: Cabletron Systems Inc shares gained more than a point Monday -- defying a general decline in networking equipment stocks -- after the company reported fiscal fourth quarter earnings in line with expectations.
Cabletron shares rose 1-1/4 to 30 on volume of 383,000 shares in early trading Monday.
Analysts said that underlying the stable financial results was a small improvment in the amount of time the company took during its latest quarter to collect accounts receivables.
A Cabletron spokesman said Days Sales Outstanding in the latest quarter fell one day to 52 versus the prior period.
The spokesman, Jim Caldwell, also said the ratio of the company's orders to sales billings was about one-to-one.

Earlier, Cabletron reported earnings for the fourth quarter ended Feb. 28 of $0.47 per share, before acquisition charges of $0.08, versus the comparable year-ago quarter's earnings of $0.35 per share, which also included charges. The First Call consensus for the latest quarter was $0.47.
The company said it had record fourth quarter sales of $380.6 million, a 26 percent increase over net sales of $302.0 million reported in the fiscal fourth quarter of last year.

"We are extremely pleased to announce our 32 quarter of consecutive record growth, the strongest and steadiest earnings growth rate among all S&P 500 companies," Cabletron President and Chief Executive S. Robert Levine said.

Levine noted that during the fourth quarter, the company had expanded its sales channel model to include more resellers and Ingram Micro Inc, the world's largest distributor, in addition to its existing direct sales force.
